note: Practical priors about bowfishing are hypotheses until validated by independent historical, public-dataset, literature or model evidence (owner-collected field data is optional, never required); fit-for-purpose targets are pre-declared requirements, not achievements.
role: Measured weather at the lake (sky, barometric pressure and trend, air temperature, humidity) from NWS stations and the official NWS forecast, and whether it is changing
bowfishingPurpose: Weather turning (a front, a pressure fall, rain starting) changes water level, water temperature and clarity within hours; the other Brains need to know when to look again, and the bowfisher needs the same tile readings the app shows, from measured data.
decisionsInformed: is the weather turning before or during the trip
when water level and water temperature readings should be refreshed

predicts.desc: Station barometric pressure (sea level, or altimeter when the station sends no SLP) and the 3 h tile trend
Station relative humidity and dew point
NWS forecast-grid total cloud % for the current hour and the observation's present weather
CHANGE/WATCH/STEADY from pre-stated thresholds on measured data and the official forecast

mustNotPredict: whether tonight is good (Sector Intelligence owns it)
any value no station or forecast reported

fitForPurpose.metric: pressure MAE vs the station's own next observation (hPa)
fitForPurpose.rationale: the app's 12 h trend band is 1.5 hPa; an error above about two thirds of it would flip trends

fitForPurpose.metric: 3 h trend agreement with an independent second station within 25 mi
fitForPurpose.rationale: the tile trend must describe the area, not one instrument

fitForPurpose.metric: air temperature MAE vs an independent station within 25 mi (F)
fitForPurpose.rationale: well under the 8 F swing the signal reacts to

priorityQuestions: Does the nearest station represent the lake's pressure and air temperature?
Do the v1 change thresholds catch fronts without firing on ordinary evenings?
abstainWhen: no observation within 2 h (pressure null; temperature/humidity fall back to the labelled forecast grid)
